title: Meth Lab HUD
description: Meth lab status: progress, next ingredient, ready.

Style.label: Style
Style.description:
HUD: a fixed spot on screen.
World: over the lab.

StyleKey.label: Style Key
StyleKey.description: Switches HUD / world / both until the next restart.

PanelX.label: Icon Position X
PanelX.description: HUD style: the icon's right edge, as a fraction of the screen width.

PanelY.label: Icon Position Y
PanelY.description: HUD style: the icon's vertical centre, as a fraction of the screen height.

WorldHeight.label: World Height
WorldHeight.description: World style: how high above the lab the icon sits (cm).

GroupRadius.label: Group Radius
GroupRadius.description: Pickups closer than this (metres) share one marker.

ReadySound.label: Ready Sound
ReadySound.description: Also plays the "meth ready" sound so you hear it anywhere.

ShowBatches.label: Show Batches
ShowBatches.description: A small number: how many more bags the lab can make.

IngredientMarkers.label: Ingredient Markers
IngredientMarkers.description: Markers over ingredient pickups, seen through walls.

HideInMenus.label: Hide In Menus
HideInMenus.description: Hides the icon while a menu is open.

PerfectColor.label: Perfect Color
PerfectColor.description: The icon when the batch is perfect.

BurntColor.label: Burnt Color
BurntColor.description: The icon when the batch is overcooked.

BoomColor.label: Destroyed Color
BoomColor.description: The red X on a destroyed lab.
